mapper.sql: uri_path, screen_id, primary_table, related_tables, data_type, table_desc, reg_id, reg_dt, update_id, update_dt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM screen_table_map ORDER BY uri_path
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO screen_table_map ( uri_path, screen_id, primary_table, related_tables, data_type, table_desc, reg_id, reg_dt, update_id, update_dt ) VALUES ( #{uriPath}, #{screenId}, #{primaryTable}, #{relatedTables}, #{dataType}, #{tableDesc}, #{regId}, #{regDt}, #{updateId}, #{updateDt} ) ON CONFLICT (uri_path) DO UPDATE SET screen_id = EXCLUDED.screen_id, primary_table = EXCLUDED.primary_table, related_tables = EXCLUDED.related_tables, data_type = EXCLUDED.data_type, table_desc = EXCLUDED.table_desc, update_id = EXCLUDED.update_id, update_dt = EXCLUDED.update_dt
